name: Dragon Scale Mail (Blue)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Sense Dragons
powers.text: Magic action: learn the distance and direction to the closest blue dragon within 30 miles (once per dawn).

summary: +1 AC, Resistance to Lightning damage, Advantage on saves against dragons' Frightful Presence and breath.
text: Crafted from the scales of a single kind of dragon, this armor grants +1 to Armor Class and Resistance to Lightning damage, and it gives you Advantage on saving throws against dragons' breath weapons and Frightful Presence. Once per dawn, by taking a Magic action to focus your senses, you learn how far away the nearest blue dragon within 30 miles is and in which direction it lies.
